title: Self-Pay Visit Package Sale in the Same Tier — System Reference
content:
**Buying the same tier again.** A Self-Pay Visit Package bought again in the same tier as the patient's previous package, and paid in full at the sale, is priced from that tier's list price; it is activated by that payment, its visits are all credited, and its expiry date is the purchase date plus the tier's validity days.

**Observable effect.** The patient holds an active package in their name with all of its visits available, the price terms and the Good Faith Estimate recorded on it, and the full price taken as a single payment.

## Situation of use and capability

The tool sells a new self-pay visit package to a patient and takes its price in full at the sale. It opens the package in the patient's name, records the price terms and the Good Faith Estimate given at the sale (the estimate equals the purchase price), takes the full purchase price as a single payment, credits all of the package's visits and sets the package active with the stated expiry date.

## How it is invoked

`purchase_visit_package_a542d834` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the patient reference number of the patient the package is bought for, read from the patient's records (profile lookup or a package history entry that names them) | identifier |
| `variant_name` | the package tier sold | exactly one tier name below |
| `clinic_name` | the clinic where the package is sold, copied exactly as the clinic name shown on the patient's own records, such as the patient's earlier visit package | verbatim text |
| `diagnosis_code` | the ICD-10-CM code of the condition the package is bought for, copied exactly as it appears on the patient's records for that condition | verbatim text |
| `surgery_date` | the surgery date for a post-surgical package | YYYY-MM-DD; an empty string "" for any other tier |
| `list_price` | the tier's list price | USD, 2 decimal places |
| `discount_kind` | the discount recorded on the package | exactly one value below |
| `discount_percent` | the total discount applied to the list price | integer percent, 0 to 100 |
| `purchase_price` | the price the patient pays | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent |
| `visits_purchased` | the visits the tier includes | non-negative integer (visits) |
| `expiry_date` | the last day the package's visits may be used | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `payment_method` | how the price is paid | exactly one value below |

**Enumerations**

- `variant_name`: Starter 4-Visit Package (the 4-visit tier); Recovery 6-Visit Package (the 6-visit tier); Core 8-Visit Package (the 8-visit tier); Complete 12-Visit Package (the 12-visit tier); Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package (the 18-visit tier for a patient with a surgery date and surgical protocol on file); Comprehensive 24-Visit Package (the 24-visit tier).
- `discount_kind`: `none` (no discount reduces the price); `renewal` (the renewal discount is the discount recorded); `member` (the Wellness Membership discount is the discount recorded).
- `payment_method`: `card` (a credit or debit card); `cash` (cash at the clinic front desk); `check` (a paper check); `hsa_fsa_card` (a health savings or flexible spending account card).

## Return

On success the tool returns a receipt with `status` "package_sold", `package_id` (reference number of the new package), `customer_id`, `variant_name`, `purchase_price` (USD, 2 decimals), `payment_event_id` (reference number of the payment entry), `credit_event_id` (reference number of the visit credit entry), `visits_remaining` (visits available) and `expiry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD).
